The user wants to implement automatic detection and restart of the LSP server if it crashes or becomes unresponsive.
I have two completed works:
T1: Looked for detection of LSP crash/non-response to trigger restart. Found `on transport reader eof`, `start`, `restart lsp for workspace`, `schedule debounced lsp restart`.
T2: Looked for the restart mechanism after detecting crash/non-response. Found `restart lsp for workspace`, `on lsp missing install`, `stop`, `start`.
T2's closed statement says: "no encontré el mecanismo de reinicio automático tras caída no-respuesta; lo leído es reinicio tras instalación de toolpack on lsp missing install y detección de EOF pasiva on transport reader eof que no dispara reinicio".
This implies that the current code does *not* have the automatic restart mechanism for crash/non-response. It only has restart on missing install and passive EOF detection that doesn't trigger restart.
The anchor claim is: "necesito que si el proceso del servidor de lenguaje LSP se cae o deja de responder, la aplicación lo detecte automáticamente y lo reinicie sin que el usuario tenga que hacer nada".
